The cast

Seventeen people across sixty years, one register and one river, met book by book. Nothing here gives away more than the back of each book does.

Five books and a diary. One family, sixty years, and the river that runs through all of it.

About the author

Manu Vishranti

A school register, a ten rupee note, a question asked every Sunday for twenty four years.

Manu Vishranti writes about the small objects a family uses to carry what it cannot say aloud. He works in English and in Hindi, building each version from the ground up rather than translating, on the understanding that a language is a way of noticing and not a set of equivalents. He also writes on meditation. The Five Wounds, five novels and one companion volume, is his first published work of fiction.

The Five Wounds by Manu Vishranti. Five novels and a companion volume: Clean Hands, Peacetime, All the Summers at Once, The House of Auspicious Hours, Dead Letter and The Third Woman.

Published by Walnut Publication. Coming the last week of October 2026. More of his work at manuvishranti.com.

The drawings in the opening are Nandita’s, from The Third Woman. Every character in these books is fictional, and every face drawn here is invented.
